fact: Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 11 March 2024, published in JORT No. 37 of 12 March 2024, amends and completes Law No. 93-27 of 22 March 1993 on the national identity card, issued by the Ministry of Interior; an organic law promulgated by the President.

fact: Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 2024 provides that the identity card carries an encrypted secure electronic chip holding the card number and fingerprint and photo, and an electronic certificate allowing identity verification and electronic signature; it leaves the card model to a decree and the certificate rules to a joint ministerial order, with no such instrument dated in the document.

fact: Access Now reports that the Ministry of Interior's fourth draft biometric ID law was approved by a ministerial council on 30 November 2023, sent to Parliament's Committee on Rights and Freedoms on 25 December 2023, and adopted by an overwhelming majority on 6 March 2024; the document does not mention promulgation.
